questions.question: What is the "setting" of a story?
options: Where and when the story takes place
questions.explanation: Setting is the time and place where the story happens.

questions.question: What does "Once upon a time" mean?
questions.explanation: "Once upon a time" is how many fairy tales begin - "Det var en gang".

questions.question: What is a "character" in a story?
questions.explanation: A character is a person (or creature) in the story.

questions.question: What should you do beføre reading?
options: Look at the title and pictures
questions.explanation: Beføre reading, look at the title and pictures to predict what the story is about.

questions.question: What is the "plot" of a story?
questions.explanation: The plot is what happens in the story - the sequence of events.
